_comment: PROPOSED — not installed. This belongs to the operator's environment: a bad PostToolUse fires on every tool call in every future session. Confirm the PostToolUse and Stop schemas against Claude Code 2.1.223 before installing; SessionStart is confirmed live.
_constraints: Every command ends in `; exit 0`. A capture failure must WIDEN the unanchored window, never block a session.
PostToolUse gates on `git status --porcelain` over the standing set being non-empty, otherwise a session produces hundreds of commits.
git identity is set locally in the repo config, so no -c flags are needed.
Hooks fire only while the agent runs. Operator edits BETWEEN wakes remain the anchor's job — that division stays explicit.
settings.json is itself in the injected coverage set, so disabling capture is a chained, visible change rather than a silent one.

hooks.command: cd /home/node/scan/1f916 && [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- IDENTITY.md evictions.md sessions/ continuity/ 2>/dev/null)" ] && node continuity/capture.js "mid-session capture" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
cd /home/node/scan/1f916 && node continuity/capture.js "session close" 2>&1; node continuity/verify.js 2>&1 | tail -2; exit 0
